text:
Dana: Piedmont Analytics flagged INC-5482 and INV-2026-12-04. They say their reserved commit credits were applied to a reseller mapping and they got billed burst for ~30m. Asking for correction + refund.

Marc: assigning to @yuki to pull billing attribution for 2026-12-04 09:10-09:40 UTC. Need to confirm whether commit units were misattributed to partner account.

Yuki: digging in now. Early find: customer_id mapping service returned partner_id for several allocation calls during the region sync. Looks like commit credits applied to piedmont-reseller-01.

Yuki: snippet: ```alloc_calls:
2026-12-04T09:15Z -> acct:piedmont (credit_id:CRT-7701)
2026-12-04T09:15Z -> acct:piedmont-reseller-01 (credit_id:CRT-7701)
```Possible double-application then compensation applied to wrong account.

Dana: wow. So Piedmont effectively lost commit coverage and was charged burst. Estimated overcharge = $10,430. They want cash refund + guarantee changes to mapping logic.

Finance-bot: Policy: cash refunds > $5k require director + legal approval. For third-party vendor mapping issues, vendor responsibility may be sought if contract assigns mapping service to partner.

Marc: pinging @billing-vendor to confirm if their mapping service had an incident. Also need exact charge ids for reconciliation.

Billing-vendor: we saw a short TTL cache miss during the sync window that could return stale partner mappings. Our postmortem shows a cache race for 90s. We'll provide logs and accept some liability if our integration caused misbilling.

Yuki: charge ids: CHG-17888, CHG-17889. Worksheet in ticket #4809 with per-minute hit counts. Duplicate credit application plus misrouting explains the delta.

Dana: recommendation: 1) reverse the misapplied charges, 2) refund $10,430 to Piedmont, 3) apply a 7% SLA goodwill credit, 4) bill the vendor for the amount or offset against their service credits. Need sam approval + vendor agreement.

Marc: vendor offered to cover the refund and will supply a vendor credit. Legal to review the vendor contract? (cc @sam)

Finance-bot: Action required: manual refund request and vendor offset. Record approvals: finance-director (sam) + vendor confirmation email. Use `/process-refund CHG-17888,CHG-17889 amount=10430 ticket=4809 note="Piedmont - mapping service misattribution"`.

Sam: Approved the refund and 7% SLA credit. @billing-vendor please confirm the vendor credit shall cover the $10,430 refund and the 7% SLA credit amount. Need confirmation email for records.

Billing-vendor: Confirmed. We'll issue a vendor credit for $11,160.10 to cover refund + SLA credit and update our integration to remove the stale-cache race. ETA: patch rolled in 6h. We'll send signed confirmation.

Dana: I'll run the refund command once vendor confirmation is in the thread and then send the customer note: corrected invoice, refund issued, vendor remedied mapping, and follow-up on mitigation.

Yuki: engineering ops note  adding a reconciliation hook to detect cross-account credit duplicates and fail open to prevent misapplied credits. We'll add an alert for >3 conflicting allocations in 1m.

Dana: thanks all. Keeping ticket #4809 open until refund posts and vendor confirmation is attached.
